private_parameters.name: X-OC-Client-Signal
private_parameters.description: Exact canonical gateway-derived v1 HMAC signal, identical to Identity delegation/authorization client_signal. Gateway strips browser copies and derives it from trusted ingress. After workload authentication, absent, duplicate (even identical), joined or malformed fields fail 400 finance_invalid_request. Never log or persist; not included in the seven-field request hash, never authority.

closure: Existing rows resolve through registry descriptor revisions and their exact operation selections plus authority/schema/protocol/workload/error dependencies. No parallel revision pins or consumer lock changes. New source candidates require full CI and selected admission before B–E.
recovery: Navigate to operation opaque reference before Sales POST; only ID in URL, no cart/amounts/PII/credentials. Authenticated lookup after reload; reference grants no authority. Replay only original immutable body/key still in RAM. 404/timeout do not prove absence of effects; losing RAM never reconstructs a sale or silently permits substitute attempt. No business storage.
